name: Wakatobi Biosphere Run 2026
short_description: Wakatobi Biosphere Run 2026 runs on Sunday 8 November 2026 in the Wakatobi islands of Southeast Sulawesi, over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.
ai_summary: Wakatobi Biosphere Run 2026 is a road race on Sunday 8 November 2026 in Wakatobi, an island regency in Southeast Sulawesi and a UNESCO biosphere reserve known for its coral reefs. It is organised by the Wakatobi regency government and offers 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. Reaching Wakatobi generally means a connecting flight or a boat from mainland Sulawesi, so it is a destination race rather than one to fit into a normal weekend.

faqs.question: When is Wakatobi Biosphere Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 8 November 2026, in Wakatobi, Southeast Sulawesi. Indonesian road races start before dawn to avoid the heat, so expect a very early flag-off and plan transport to the start the night before rather than on the morning.

faqs.question: What distances does Wakatobi Biosphere Run 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The half marathon is the headline distance, and the shorter races are aimed at newer runners and those who want a faster morning. Entry fees and cut-off times are set by the organiser, so check the official registration page before entering.
